data.name: CABARET 4 CARD
data.detailed_description:
Your hand and your opponent's hand are fully revealed. A complete information battle with only 4 cards


You play with only 4 cards.

Cards are dealt randomly, but both your hand and your opponent's hand are fully revealed from the beginning of the game.


Analyze your opponent's possible moves and find the best strategy.

Victory depends not on hidden information or luck, but on logic and decision-making.

Victory conditions change with every move


In this game, simply playing a strong card is not enough to win.


"Play this card to win."

"Play this card and lose."

"The player who plays the final card wins."


Read the changing victory conditions and discover the path to victory before your opponent does.

Deep strategy created by complete information


Your choices and your opponent's possible moves are always visible.

Predict several moves ahead and build the optimal sequence of actions.


Every decision can determine the outcome in this deep logic-based card game.

Simple rules, endless possibilities


The rules are easy to learn.

But the more you search for the perfect move, the more strategies and discoveries you will find.


A complete information card battle recommended for fans of chess, strategy games, and puzzles.
